sn12.22:2.1: “Stripped of patchwork” is ironic given that this is, in fact, a patchwork discourse. This passage appears at [mn22:42.1](), where it has a meaningful context.
sn12.22:2.2: This sentence is not entirely coherent. The opening phrase is normally followed by “those who”, while _alameva_ follows the accusative, not the locative.
sn12.22:3.1: Elsewhere we find, “in a well explained teaching and training a lazy person lives in suffering” at [an1.325:1.1](), and “mixed up with bad, unskilful qualities” at [an3.40:2.11]().
sn12.22:3.8: Note that these sentences appear in reverse order at AN 7.72
